Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}

The curse of the Nosferatu twists every member into a hideous, inhuman visage the moment they are Embraced, forcing them into the sewers and shadows of the city. In exchange for their monstrous appearance, the clan has become unmatched at gathering secrets and moving unseen, trading information as their chief currency of power.

Disciplines: Animalism, Obfuscate, Potence

Advantage: Nosferatu are masters of stealth and information-gathering, leveraging Obfuscate and their extensive underground networks to learn secrets others cannot.

Disadvantage: Every Nosferatu is hideously deformed and cannot hide this appearance from normal observers; they cannot initiate social challenges other than intimidation while their true form is visible, and can never possess attractive social Traits.

Organization: Maintain extensive tunnel networks and information brokerages beneath their home cities, trading secrets with other clans in exchange for protection and resources.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{the Camarilla}, of which Nosferatu is one of the founding clans.
